data.name: Neurowake
data.detailed_description:
Neurowake is a team-based FPS game, designed exclusively for VR. Choose between one of five epic heroes, each with their own unique weapons and skills and compete across a variety of environments and match types.

Story


The Awakening brought chaos to the world, tearing it to pieces and setting up the foundation for a new global order, new threats, allies, and obstacles to overcome. Separated by ideology and belief, you must take on the responsibility of a member loyal to the UWC or choose to stand for freedom with the resistance. Whatever your decision - it's time to prove your worth on the battlefield.

Heroes


Take part in online battles as a UWC representative or a resistance hero and take down those that oppose your faction. Combine real world skills with unique abilities to become the ultimate Neurowake champion. Five epic hero characters are available in Neurowake Early Access now.

Teleportation in VR


Where most VR shooters tend to have a slow game pace. Our unique chessboard teleportation method brings intensive fast gameplay to virtual reality allowing you to focus on your what really matters. Taking out other players.

Weapon & Skill


Every Neurowake hero is equipped with a unique set of weapons. Blasting your opponents away with double wielded shotguns up close or a tactful sniper kill. The choice is yours.
Don’t forget the skill. The heroes are all with augmented power, from X-Vison to Ghost Cloak, which might make you be the game changer.

Game Mode


Free-for-all and Team Death Match are here. Need a new challenge? Siege mode will do the trick. Neurowake offers three classic game modes that guarantee one hell of a VR ride.

Map


The awakening has left its mark on the world. Battles have taken place in the most remote locations. From the sewers down below to the amazon jungle. You get to prove your worth all over the world in unique environments designed to give a thrilling VR experience.

reviews.review:
Neurowake is a competitive shooter, a slippery kind of game in VR: players interested in multiplayer are not enough and mainly focused on just a couple of titles. In fact during my tries I can't find any opponent. Where this can't be addressed to devs, and can't be used to give a bad review, it's surely something to consider for a potential customer. Neurowake - at the moment at least - miss any AI bot, it offers just a training mode with waves or "brainless" mechs than is extremely poor and boring.

I was optimistic about the game at his start: 3.7GB to download, Vive X Accelerator support and I like any original solution for locomotion than put comfort as main goal, that "chessboard teleportation" looked something than worth a try. From the tech side, it's an hit-and-miss because we find some sharp textures and good menus and UI, cool musics, mixed with so so environments and bland and toylike weapons.

Chessboard teleportation is a nice idea and is actually ideal for stairs, but it's hard to me say how well this can work in a real match with humans, in the training was just horrible because you need to run up and down and you can't. You have some point action, any step use an amount of those point, so you can't teleport all the time because you need to recover those points.

It's the very first release, so performance issues and bugs are normal. The bigger issue is the tutorial at the moment, it doesn't work, I tried like five time to be able to end it and also stutters a lot (is averagely smooth in other modes).

For what it offers now is hard for me to suggest Neurowake to someone. I hoped in something like Smashbox Arena meet Unreal Tournament, but Smasbox is on a whole different quality level and Unreal can be seen just in menus and soundtrack, not really in the game. Surely it can grow, I hope so for Neurowake developers, but Gunheart is out of the corner and there are yet plenty of better MP games, half of them dying because of missing players.
